slots.title: Brazil assets hit after election
slots.body:

That is an emerging-markets macro story, not a single U.S. print.

- Gold futures: +0.4%
- Bitcoin: +0.3% to 78,466.95

slots.title: US session recap — Nov. 1, 2026
slots.body:
The S&P 500 closed at 7,580.07, down 140.32 points (-1.8%) from the prior close of 7,720.39, with an intraday range of 7,527.56 to 7,637.48.

The Nasdaq Composite took the largest major-index hit, finishing at 25,437.00 (-747.73 points, -2.9%) after trading between 25,177.33 and 25,673.00.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended at 51,770.31 (-572.25 points, -1.1%); the Russell 2000 closed at 2,811.84 (-47.37 points, -1.7%).

The VIX rose 12.9% to 19.42 from 17.20, with a session high of 23.93, alongside the equity decline.

Semiconductor-linked megacaps were among the heaviest weights in the tape: Taiwan Semiconductor ($TSM) -5.9% to 406.13, ASML ($ASML) -6.6% to 1,565.90, Broadcom ($AVGO) -5.5% to 326.08, and NVIDIA ($NVDA) -4.2% to 204.64; leveraged chip ETFs showed the same split (:
- $SOXL -24.7%
- $SOXS +25.0%

).

Other large technology names closed lower: Microsoft ($MSFT) -1.6% to 521.91, Alphabet ($GOOG) -1.5% to 278.22, Meta ($META) -1.5% to 614.99, and Apple ($AAPL) -1.2% to 344.63.

Intel ($INTC) was the most active liquid name in the data and closed -28.6% at 65.76; Reddit ($RDDT) finished -29.3% at 91.67 among the largest percentage decliners in the liquid screen.

On the upside, Eli Lilly ($LLY) gained 3.2% to 1,417.54 with a session high of 1,449.68; PepsiCo ($PEP) +2.7% to 137.34; Costco ($COST) +1.8% to 1,012.28; AbbVie ($ABBV) +1.4% to 294.89; Chevron ($CVX) +1.8% to 235.52.

Treasury yields in the injected snapshot (dated 2026-10-30) showed the 10-year at 4.9% and the 2s10s spread at 0.38 percentage points.

Gold futures (GCUSD) closed up 0.4% at 3,916.40; Brent crude (BZUSD) was down 3.0% at 109.75; the USO oil fund ticked up 0.4% to 168.83; Bitcoin (BTCUSD) was up 0.3% at 78,460.55; the dollar proxy UUP was -0.1% at 29.00.

Overseas indexes in the bundle were mixed versus the US drop: Hang Seng +0.6%, Nikkei +0.3%, FTSE +0.1%, while the Germany proxy EWG was -1.2%.

The economic calendar listed a US OPEC Meeting on 2026-11-01 at 10:00 with medium impact; the injected earnings calendar for the bundle was empty.
